meta.title: Add predicate pushdown and update Scala goldens
meta.body_summary: Introduce predicate pushdown (preWhere) in Scala compiler and update golden test outputs; also register to_json as a builtin and update types/check.go.

core_change_summary.description: In compile/x/scala/compiler.go and runtime.go, modified the Scala compiler to emit preWhere clauses (predicate pushdown) when no join sides are used, and updated the _query helper to use preWhere. Registered to_json as a builtin in types/check.go. Updated numerous Scala golden test output files to reflect the new generated code.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Golden file updates account for the majority of changed lines; the new dataset_where_pushdown.scala.out is the largest single addition.
